name: registry-db-tests
description: Runs db/migrations and db/tests/*.test.sql on an in-process Postgres (PGlite). Separate from the app so it does not touch the app lockfile.

scripts.test: node run.mjs && node --test load.test.mjs review.test.mjs takedown.test.mjs search.test.mjs drafts.test.mjs hardening.test.mjs
